articles.summary: Most kids his age are playing video games. Ethan, 13, is shipping open-source software. This is what coding classes for kids can produce when the environment gets it right.
articles.title: Ethan Started Coding Classes at 9. At 13, He Built His Own Browser.

articles.summary: Trinket is now free for every classroom. When trinket.io wound down, Strive took over hosting the open-source Trinket platform at trinket.strivemath.org — no paywalls, no cost, just the trusted Trinket you already love.
articles.title: Trinket Lives On at trinket.strivemath.org

articles.summary: Zoe is in Grade 10. Last week she deployed a fully working quote generator with animated card flips, custom images, and a UI she designed herself. Here's what real coding projects for kids can actually look like.
articles.title: Most Kids Learn to Code. Zoe Published a Real App.
